covered_actors: Providers of general-purpose AI models with systemic risk
Entities making significant modifications to AI models
Authorised representatives of GPAI model providers
compliance_deadlines: 2025-08-02: Obligations for providers of GPAI models enter into application; providers of GPAI models placed on the market after this date must comply and systemic-risk model providers must notify the AI Office.
2026-08-02: European Commission enforcement powers for GPAI model provider obligations enter into application, including fines.
2027-08-02: Providers of GPAI models placed on the market before 2 August 2025 must comply.
penalties_summary: From 2 August 2026, the European Commission's enforcement powers enter into application to enforce compliance with GPAI model provider obligations, including with fines.
implementation_notes: Official European Commission policy webpage (last updated 2026-03-26) summarizing the non-binding Guidelines for providers of general-purpose AI models under the EU AI Act. Although not legally binding, the guidelines reflect the Commission's interpretation of key terms (such as general-purpose criteria, significant modifications, and open-source exemptions) and guide enforcement alongside the voluntary GPAI Code of Practice. Providers (or their authorised representatives) must use the EU SEND platform to submit notifications, reassessment requests, serious incident reports, and compliance reports to the AI Office.
